newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Strike ends at Northam after wage deal.
newsitem.headline: Strike ends at Northam after wage deal.

text.p: South Africa's National Union of Mineworkers said on Tuesday that a strike at Northam platinum mine ended on Monday following a wage agreement.
The NUM said it had won an "honourable deal" of an additional 4.5 percent pay rise, to establish parity between Northam and other mines in the Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd group.
An agreement was also reached on a 10 percent wage increase, so that workers will receive a 14.5 percent increase in total.
The union added that it had agreed with management on ways to make up for production lost during the strike, which began last Thursday.

Northam produced 75,365 ounces of precious metals in concentrates in the three months to September. The mine recorded a net loss before capital spending of 7.39 million rand in the September quarter after turning in a profit of 8.17 million in the previous quarter.
